d: Russia, Ukraine and the United States have concluded two days of trilateral peace talks in Abu Dhabi, with no major breakthrough to end the nearly five-year war. Washington reported some openings, while negotiators described the discussions as difficult. However, Moscow and Kyiv confirmed that a major prisoner exchange could take place soon. US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are set to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin before travelling to Dublin for talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.
